AP® Calculus AB/BC 2021 Scoring Guidelines
Scoring notes:
• To earn the first point a response must list all three conditions: e−x
is positive, decreasing, and
continuous.
• The second point is earned for correctly writing the improper integral or for presenting a correct
limit equivalent to the improper integral (for example,
b
lim e−x
dx ).
b→∞∫0
• To earn the third point a response must correctly use limit notation to evaluate the improper integral,
find an evaluation of e0
(or 1), and conclude that the integral converges or that the series
converges.
• If an incorrect lower limit of 1 is used in the improper integral, then the second point is not earned.
In this case, if the correct limit (1 e) is presented, then the response is eligible for the third point.
• If the response only relies on using a geometric series approach, then no points are earned [0-0-0].
• A response that presents an evaluation with ∞, such as e−∞ = 0, does not earn the third point.
Total for part (a) 3 points
